items.raw_excerpt: Jovens e indígenas levantam desafios comuns e cobram respostas para além da COP da Desertificação
items.summary_en: Indigenous and youth delegates at the UN desertification conference shared personal stories from Peru, El Salvador, and Argentina. They highlighted how droughts and floods threaten food, culture, and livelihoods across Latin America. The delegates called for more international support and a stronger voice in policy decisions.

items.title_en: Latin America faces shared climate and land challenges

items.raw_excerpt: It was a light bulb moment: If monsoon rains keep kids from safely getting to school, let's create a floating school to pick them up! Bangladesh pioneered the idea. How's it doing?
items.summary_en: Monsoon rains often make it too dangerous for children to walk to school. Floating schools ride on boats to pick students up from their villages. Bangladesh created the idea and the program is still running today.
items.summary_ko: 몬순 비가 내리면 아이들이 학교에 걸어 가기엔 너무 위험해진다. 방글라데시에서는 배 위에서 운영하는 수상 학교를 만들어 아이들을 직접 태우러 다닌다. 이 아이디어의 원조인 방글라데시에서 아직도 프로그램이 이어지고 있다.

items.title_original: Whatever happened to the floating schools of Bangladesh?

items.summary_en: Hundreds of masked demonstrators in black clothing blocked roads in Dover, UK. A local councillor reported the protest appeared to be coordinated and related to illegal migration. The demonstration caused disruption in the port town near the English Channel.

items.raw_excerpt: Despite a spike in international crude oil prices, state-owned oil supplier CPC Corp., Taiwan said Saturday that it will keep its domestic gasoline and diesel prices steady next week.
items.summary_en: Taiwan's state-owned CPC Corp. will not change gasoline or diesel prices next week. This decision comes even as international crude oil prices have risen sharply. The move aims to keep domestic fuel costs stable for consumers.

items.raw_excerpt: When most people think of Portugal's greatest treasures, they picture golden beaches, world-famous wines, historic cities or perhaps Cristiano Ronaldo. Yet hidden among rolling Alentejo estates, historic royal stud farms, and centuries-old breeding traditions is another Portuguese icon that has quietly earned international admiration and, in some cases, a price tag of more than €1 million.
items.summary_en: Hidden in the Alentejo region of Portugal, the Lusitano horse is a prized breed with centuries of royal breeding tradition. These horses now carry price tags of over one million euros and have won international admiration. The breed is a quiet icon of Portuguese heritage and horsemanship.
items.summary_ko: 포르투갈 알렌테호 지역에 숨겨진 루시타노 말은 수백 년의 왕실 사육 전통을 이어온 품종입니다. 이 말들의 가치는 때때로 100만 유로를 넘어서며 국제적인 찬사를 받고 있습니다. 루시타노는 포르투갈의 소중한 문화유산이자 승마 유산으로 자리잡았습니다.
items.title_en: Portugal's Million-Euro Horses: Inside the World of the Lusitano

items.raw_excerpt: Fifteen-year-old Su Bo-ling (蘇柏陵) won Taiwan's first-ever medal at the World Aquatics Junior Open Water Swimming Championships in Argentina on Friday, after clinching bronze in the men's 7.5-kilometer race.
items.summary_en: Fifteen-year-old Su Bo-ling won bronze in the men's 7.5-kilometer race at the World Aquatics Junior Open Water Swimming Championships in Argentina. This marks Taiwan's first-ever medal at this international competition. The young swimmer made history for Taiwanese open water swimming.

items.raw_excerpt: Fermented tea kombucha has been around for millennia, with proven health benefits. In Mexico, however, it is a more recent phenonmenon.

items.raw_excerpt: NEWCASTLE, England, Sept 5 : Bournemouth made Premier League history in a 2-2 draw at Newcastle United on Saturday by becoming the first club to score first in their opening three games of a season without winning any of them.Marco Rose's side dropped points from a winning position for the third straight game
items.summary_en: Bournemouth made Premier League history by becoming the first team to score first in their opening three games of a season without winning any of them.
